newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.120PTS TO 103.325.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.120PTS TO 103.325.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.120 points in Friday's trading to 103.325 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.819 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.217 points to 100.875, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.359 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 3.962 points to 1,027.195.
